param: B Constant influx (birth/recruitment) rate of human hosts into susceptible class S_h(0,t)=B.
μₕ Natural death rate of human hosts.
μᵥ Natural death rate of mosquitoes (vectors).
βₕ(a) Age-specific transmission/contact rate from infected mosquitoes to susceptible humans (vector-to-human). Appears in force of infection βₕ(a) Iᵥ(t) S_h(a,t)/N_h(t).
βᵥ(a) Age-specific transmission rate from infectious humans (I_h and A_h) to susceptible mosquitoes (human-to-vector). Appears inside integral ∫ βᵥ(a)(I_h+σA_h) da / N_h(t).
k(a) Age-specific progression rate from exposed to infectious (inverse of age-specific latent period).
ρ Probability an exposed host becomes symptomatic infectious (E_h → I_h). (1-ρ) becomes asymptomatic (E_h → A_h).
σ Factor characterizing intensity of reinfection of asymptomatic infectious hosts; also scales contribution of A_h to mosquito infection and appears in A_h → I_h reinfection term.
γ₁(a) Age-specific recovery rate of symptomatic infectious humans (I_h → R_h).
γ₂(a) Age-specific recovery rate of asymptomatic infectious humans (A_h → R_h).
Nₕ(t) Total human population size at time t used for standard incidence normalization.
Iᵥ(t) Proportion of infectious mosquitoes at time t (vector population is rescaled to total 1).
